description: 3,750 kVA / 3,000 kW prime diesel genset, three per side (N+1), transferring through the ATS within 15 s (plant-design basis).

coolant_loss.description: A coolant leak: the low coolant level alarm rises and a running engine heats up until its high coolant temperature shutdown locks it out.

derate.description: Engine or alternator fault limits the output.

capacity_fraction.description: Available output as a fraction of prime.

emergency_stop.description: The emergency stop is pressed: the genset stops and stays locked out until the button is released and it is reset.

fail_to_start.description: The engine fails to start (over-crank at the end of its start time) and locks out until reset.

low_oil_pressure.description: An oil leak or a failing oil pump lowers the lubricating oil pressure; below the prealarm the controller warns, below the shutdown pressure the engine's protection stops the set and locks it out.

pressure_fraction.description: Oil pressure as a fraction of normal.

shutdown.description: The alternator's short-circuit protection trips a running genset and locks it out until reset.

name: Diesel generator set

fuel_flow_full_load.description: Fuel consumption at prime power (about 0.27 L/kWh).

overload_limit.description: Output, as a fraction of available power, above which the overload protection times out.

overload_time.description: Time above the overload limit before the genset shuts down and locks out.

p_prime.description: Prime power rating (site data: plant-design.json basis.capacities: Gensets).

s_rated.description: Apparent power rating (site data: plant-design.json basis.capacities: Gensets).

start_time.description: Time from start signal to ready to accept load; within the site's 15 s ATS transfer.

fuel_in.description: Day-tank supply from the bulk diesel tank.

power_out.description: Generator output to the ATS / genset bus.
